fields.DESCRIPTION: Add elegance and charm to your home décor with this exquisite hand-painted Rajasthani swan pair, crafted by skilled artisans of Rajasthan. Symbolizing love, grace, and togetherness, these swans are a perfect representation of harmony and beauty. Made from high-quality marble, each swan is adorned with vibrant red, gold, and floral hand-painted motifs in traditional Rajasthani style. The fine detailing and smooth finish reflect the rich cultural artistry of Rajasthan.
